41522042.dataset_size: RSNA pediatric bone age public dataset (standard split)
41522042.headline_result: Mean absolute error 4.82 months (range 3.39-6.03 months across age/sex subgroups).
41522042.study_design: Retrospective model development study using a public dataset.

41522390.clinical_problem: Comparing predictive tools, including an AI-based model, for the risk of CSF diversion after posterior fossa tumor resection to improve neurosurgical decision-making.
41522390.patient_population: Pediatric and adult patients undergoing posterior fossa tumor resection (predominantly pediatric: 67.3% of pooled cohort)
41522390.model_description: Systematic review comparing ten predictive models (mostly logistic regression, one AI-based model using intraoperative/postoperative imaging patterns) for predicting need for CSF diversion after posterior fossa tumor resection.
41522390.headline_result: The AI-based model showed the best performance among reviewed tools, AUC = 0.938.
41522390.study_design: Systematic review (PRISMA) of predictive model performance.

41530419.exclusion_reason: Uses standard 2D clinical photographs rather than radiologic imaging (explicitly contrasted with X-ray, CT and photogrammetry approaches)

41541682.clinical_problem: Automated detection and localization of pediatric femoral neck fractures on hip radiographs to support emergency diagnosis.
41541682.patient_population: Pediatric patients undergoing hip radiography across eight centers
41541682.model_description: Input: pediatric hip radiographs. Output: bounding-box detection and localization of femoral neck fractures; AI assistance evaluated in a reader study with emergency-department orthopedic surgeons.
41541682.dataset_size: 2,594 hip radiographs from 2,116 patients across 8 centers
41541682.headline_result: Internal test: mAP@0.5 90.6%, AUC 0.921; external test: mAP@0.5 96.8%, AUC 0.968; AI assistance significantly improved less-experienced readers' diagnostic performance.
41541682.study_design: Retrospective multicenter model development and validation study with reader study.

41550306.model_family: Multivariate machine learning (unspecified) alongside volumetric/microstructural group comparison
41550306.body_region: subcortical brain structures (caudate, putamen, globus pallidus, thalamus, hippocampus)
41550306.clinical_problem: Characterizing subcortical structural and microstructural brain correlates of developmental language disorder in children and adolescents.
41550306.patient_population: Children and adolescents with developmental language disorder, a history of language difficulties, and typically developing controls
41550306.model_description: Input: T1-weighted and diffusion MRI of subcortical structures. Volume and microstructure (DTI, NODDI) are compared between groups; multivariate machine learning relates hippocampal measures to language skills.
41550306.dataset_size: 156 children/adolescents (54 DLD, 74 typically developing, 28 with language-difficulty history), aged 10:0-15:11
41550306.study_design: Case-control structural and diffusion MRI study.

41585020.exclusion_reason: Clinical/surgical management review of pediatric nasal dermoid cysts; AI/radiomics mentioned only briefly as a future translational direction

41590611.exclusion_reason: Benchtop NMR spectroscopy (metabolomics) review; not radiologic imaging and not pediatric-focused

41608688.clinical_problem: Reviewing AI-assisted diagnosis of pediatric pulmonary tuberculosis, including imaging-based approaches, and their limitations.
41608688.patient_population: Children and adolescents with (or being screened for) pulmonary tuberculosis (review, no single study population)
41608688.model_description: Narrative review of AI (deep learning, NLP, computer vision, multimodal fusion) combined with medical imaging, laboratory and pathology data for pediatric pulmonary tuberculosis diagnosis; discusses limitations including scarce pediatric data, limited interpretability, and lack of external validation.

41625756.clinical_problem: Predicting extrapulmonary organ involvement and recovery duration in children with Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia using CT radiomics.
41625756.patient_population: Children with confirmed Mycoplasma pneumoniae pneumonia across three medical centers
41625756.model_description: Input: chest CT radiomics features plus clinical laboratory and image features. Output: predicted probability of extrapulmonary organ involvement and estimated recovery duration.
41625756.headline_result: Integrated model AUC 0.94 (95% CI 0.84-0.99), versus 0.73 for radiomics alone and 0.67 for clinical laboratory alone.
41625756.study_design: Retrospective multicenter radiomics model development study.

41625940.model_family: U-Net++ (segmentation) plus Faster R-CNN + HRNet + Attention U-Net (hybrid prototypes)
41625940.clinical_problem: Automating fetal biometric measurements (head circumference, abdominal circumference, femur length) from ultrasound to reduce operator-dependent variability in growth assessment.
41625940.patient_population: Fetuses undergoing routine obstetric ultrasound (public HC18 dataset plus institutional images)
41625940.model_description: Input: 2D obstetric ultrasound images. Output: automated head-circumference measurement (U-Net++ segmentation with convex-hull fitting) and prototype abdominal-circumference (Faster R-CNN+HRNet+Attention U-Net) and femur-length modules.
41625940.dataset_size: HC18 public dataset, n=1,334 images (test n=110); additional institutional AC/FL images
41625940.headline_result: Head-circumference module: MAE 9.7 mm, accuracy 0.90, sensitivity 0.97; abdominal-circumference prototype: mean difference 5.5±3.1 mm from manual reference.
41625940.study_design: Retrospective proof-of-concept model development study using public and institutional datasets.

41625979.exclusion_reason: Qualitative survey of resident physicians' perceptions of AI in medical education; no imaging model or pediatric radiology focus

41798692.exclusion_reason: Adult population (mothers with borderline personality disorder); conventional task-based fMRI activation analysis, no AI/ML model

41841031.exclusion_reason: Generative-modeling methods paper evaluated mainly on adult/elderly (ADNI Alzheimer's) data; no pediatric-specific clinical results reported

41994563.exclusion_reason: General review of automated ventricular segmentation methods spanning adult and pediatric neurological disease; not specifically pediatric-focused

42027349.clinical_problem: Reviewing current and emerging AI applications across pediatric orthopedic imaging and care, including hip dysplasia screening and bone age assessment.
42027349.patient_population: Pediatric orthopedic patients (review, no single study population)
42027349.model_description: Narrative review covering AI-driven automated ultrasound analysis for DDH screening, machine-learning-based bone age determination, AI-powered robotic surgical planning and 3D deformity modeling, and wearable/video-based gait analysis in pediatric orthopedics.

42027422.exclusion_reason: Single-cell Raman spectroscopy of surgical tissue specimens; a non-radiologic, histology/microscopy-adjacent technique

42117114.model_name: HKD-MGIN (Heat Kernel Diffused Multi-task Graph Isomorphism Network)
42117114.model_family: Graph neural network (physics-informed, graph isomorphism network)
42117114.clinical_problem: Modeling adolescent brain connectivity dynamics to estimate brain age and identify biomarkers of cognitive maturation.
42117114.model_description: Input: multi-task resting/task fMRI functional connectivity. A heat-kernel-diffusion graph isomorphism network estimates brain age and classifies sex, revealing functional circuits linked to cognitive maturation.
42117114.headline_result: Brain-age estimation RMSE 1.864±0.157, MAE 1.492±0.139, r=0.816; sex classification accuracy 0.802, AUC 0.834.

42328105.exclusion_reason: Adult-only study (ages 36-89); pediatric population referenced only as prior/other published work, not this study's cohort

42433290.clinical_problem: Automatically distinguishing fetal heart activity from umbilical cord blood flow in low-cost 1D Doppler ultrasound recordings to improve usability for untrained users in low-resource settings.
42433290.patient_population: Pregnant women monitored with low-cost 1D Doppler ultrasound
42433290.model_description: Input: power spectrum (relative energy per 10 Hz interval) of 1D Doppler ultrasound recordings. Output: classification of signal source as fetal heart activity versus umbilical cord blood flow.
42433290.headline_result: AUC 0.82; accuracy 75% for fetal heart identification and 84% for umbilical cord identification.

37262115.model_family: Deep learning (CNN with learnable atrous spatial pyramid pooling)
37262115.clinical_problem: Automating fetal middle cerebral artery segmentation and Doppler gate placement to reduce sonographer workload when assessing risk of adverse perinatal outcomes.
37262115.patient_population: Fetuses undergoing Doppler ultrasound assessment (collaboration with International Peace Maternity and Child Health Hospital of China)
37262115.model_description: Input: fetal ultrasound Doppler images. Output: automated segmentation of the middle cerebral artery region and detection of the correct Doppler gate position, via a CNN with a learnable atrous spatial pyramid pooling module.

37292481.clinical_problem: Benchmarking automated segmentation algorithms for pediatric brain gliomas via a standardized multi-institutional challenge, to speed development of tools useful for clinical trials and care.
37292481.patient_population: Children with high-grade glioma across multiple international pediatric neuro-oncology consortia
37292481.model_description: A community challenge (BraTS-PEDs 2023) providing standardized multiparametric structural MRI training, validation and test data for pediatric brain glioma, to benchmark volumetric segmentation algorithms using shared quantitative performance metrics.

37781823.exclusion_reason: Dental imaging (CBCT of children's teeth for oral diagnosis)

37961086.model_family: Deep learning segmentation (pretrained on adult data, fine-tuned) plus ML classifiers on radiomic features
37961086.clinical_problem: Predicting 1-year overall survival in pediatric diffuse midline glioma using automated MRI radiomics.
37961086.patient_population: Pediatric patients with diffuse midline glioma at two centers
37961086.model_description: Input: multisequence MRI (T1, T1ce, T2, T2 FLAIR) at diagnosis and post-radiation. A deep-learning model (pretrained on adult brain tumor data, fine-tuned) automatically segments tumor core/whole tumor; extracted radiomic features feed ML models predicting 1-year survival.
37961086.dataset_size: 53 internal and 16 external pediatric DMG patients
37961086.headline_result: 1-year overall survival prediction accuracy 77-85% (internal) and 78-81% (external); segmentation Dice: tumor core 0.91/0.74, whole tumor 0.88/0.86 (internal/external).
37961086.study_design: Two-center retrospective model development study with external validation.

38019619.body_region: fetus (scan-plane detection) and breast (secondary adult task)
38019619.clinical_problem: Improving deep-learning performance on data-scarce obstetric/gynecologic ultrasound tasks, including fetal ultrasound scan-plane detection, by using prior spatial information during training.
38019619.patient_population: Obstetric/gynecologic ultrasound patients (fetal scan-plane detection task and a secondary adult breast-cancer detection task)
38019619.model_description: Input: ultrasound images. A novel training method (Prior-Guided Attribution) incorporates spatial prior maps to guide deep neural network attribution during training only, improving performance on fetal ultrasound scan-plane detection (using segmentation prior maps) and breast cancer detection.
38019619.study_design: Methodological study introducing a training technique, evaluated on two ultrasound tasks.

38196752.clinical_problem: Investigating domain-shift and generalization challenges of deep-learning models estimating white-matter fiber orientation in newborn and infant brains across scanners and ages.
38196752.patient_population: Newborns and infants ("babies") from two cohorts undergoing diffusion MRI
38196752.model_description: Input: diffusion MRI from newborn and infant brains, from different scanners/protocols. Deep-learning models estimate fiber orientation distribution functions; the study evaluates cross-age and cross-site domain shift and mitigation via fine-tuning with a small number of target-domain samples.

38262133.clinical_problem: Automated brain extraction (segmentation) from fetal MRI in twin pregnancies, a case not addressed by existing single-fetus methods.
38262133.model_description: Input: twin fetal MRI images. An object detector locates both fetal brains at once, then TFBE-Net segments brain regions for each, using a two-step training strategy that leverages single-fetus brain correlation features.
38262133.study_design: Algorithm development and evaluation study (twin fetal MRI).

38269715.exclusion_reason: Dental imaging (panoramic radiograph GAN generation/reconstruction, evaluated by pediatric dentists)

38460184.clinical_problem: Diagnosing acute pancreatitis in children with pancreaticobiliary maljunction when CT findings are nonobvious, using a radiomics-clinical nomogram.
38460184.patient_population: Children with pancreaticobiliary maljunction evaluated for acute pancreatitis
38460184.model_description: Input: pancreatic CT radiomics features plus clinical parameters. Output: nomogram predicting presence of acute pancreatitis in children with nonobvious CT findings.
38460184.study_design: Single-center retrospective radiomics-clinical nomogram development study.

38478573.clinical_problem: Assessing fetal femur development (ossification center parameters) using AI to aid prenatal detection of skeletal anomalies.
38478573.patient_population: Human fetuses aged 17-30 weeks from spontaneous miscarriages and preterm deliveries
38478573.model_description: Input: gestational age and femur length. Output: an MLP (2-3-2-5 architecture) predicts five parameters of the femoral shaft primary ossification center (linear dimensions, cross-sectional areas, volume) derived from CT/digital image analysis.
38478573.headline_result: Correlation between predicted and actual values: R=0.955 (training), 0.942 (validation), 0.953 (testing).

38496517.clinical_problem: Improving image quality of pediatric cerebral perfusion MRI (multi-delay arterial spin labeling) to more reliably quantify cerebral blood flow and arterial transit time in children.
38496517.patient_population: Typically developing children undergoing test-retest perfusion MRI
38496517.model_description: Input: multi-delay arterial spin labeling perfusion MRI images. A Transformer-based deep-learning model, trained using k-space-weighted-image-average denoised references, denoises images to improve SNR and repeatability of cerebral blood flow and arterial transit time maps.
38496517.dataset_size: 21 typically developing children aged 8-17 years, test-retest scans

38498203.exclusion_reason: Animal model study (Sprague-Dawley rat fetuses with nitrofen-induced CDH), not human

38591261.exclusion_reason: Disaster-response e-health commentary; a pediatric X-ray deep-learning tool is mentioned only in passing as one platform feature, with no methods or results provided

38594715.clinical_problem: Correlating longitudinal brain volumetric changes, measured with 3D machine learning models, with clinical/neurodevelopmental outcome in a case of severe perinatal asphyxia.
38594715.patient_population: A single term infant with perinatal asphyxia (case report)
38594715.model_description: Input: longitudinal 3D brain MRI. Output: ML-based volumetric analysis of basal ganglia, thalamus and cerebellar structures over time in a newborn with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, correlated with clinical neurodevelopmental outcome.
38594715.study_design: Case report with longitudinal 3D volumetric MRI analysis.
